name: Info for Flux
author: Tom Moulton

sections.description:
Displays dApp expiration date and other Flux network info
Will display notices about app specification updates that should be done.

Getting Started

Install and visit Settings page

Is it free to use?

This plugin is completely free with no paid version.

Please consider helping out by leaving a review, or donate.

Third Party Sites

This plugin will access API Services (https://api.runonflux.io) of the Flux Network (see https://docs.runonflux.io)
This plugin will also access by IP address Flux Nodes that your application is running in to check the state of the app.

The Flux Application name (‘wordpress178…..’) is used in a few of the API calls GET only, no data is POSTED.

Privacy Policy: https://runonflux.io/privacyPolicy
Terms and Conditions: https://runonflux.io/termsandconditions
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘infoforflux.zip’ to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Customise plugin settings in WordPress admin at Settings > infoforflux
